issue: OQ8 (line 115) states the Kokoro footprint/latency question is 'resolve at impl by MEASURING' with a concrete trigger ('if CPU latency > the ~500-800ms budget, fall back to Piper') — this is a real, testable proof obligation. But §4's RED test plan (line 105), which was otherwise correctly rewritten to be Pipecat/pytest-appropriate (service config, fail-closed selection, auth gate, no-mock pipeline smoke, plus C2/C3/C1-fallback/C5/C6 items), contains NO corresponding item for this benchmark. There is no named test, script, or gate anywhere in §4 that forces the Kokoro CPU-latency measurement to actually run and forces the Piper fallback decision if the budget is exceeded. Without a named proof obligation, OQ8's 'benchmark before shipping' is an unenforced aspiration, not a provable requirement — exactly the gap the project's own GLVS goal condition rejects ('proven by real side-effect E2E + adversary PASS').
